subject: QBR prep: runway consolidation + account playbooks (Avery Health & top mid-market accounts)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR prep: runway consolidation + account playbooks (Avery Health & top mid-market accounts)

Team —

We need a tight, deliverable-ready packet for the QBR readout on Nov 17. Focus areas: consolidated forecast (net new & expansion), 90-day runway, and an account-by-account playbook for the top 8 mid-market deals (Avery included).

As a quick rubric: each account playbook should be a one-page (PDF) with: current ARR, committed next-step, primary blocker, decision maker, recent risk signals, recommended next action (owner + ETA). I attached a short QBR-template (QBR-template-v2.xlsx) and an example playbook for Avery (avery-account-playbook-v1.pdf).

Immediate asks (please):
- Rishi: can you consolidate the per-owner forecasts into a single rollup CSV by EoD Tue? I want a line for ARR, weighted forecast, and runway impact. (attachment: forecast-rollup-20261109.csv — your source CSV is fine)
- Marissa: please produce the one-page playbooks for Avery + three other at-risk mid-market deals (prioritize Renewal/Expansion risk). Drop PDFs into the shared Drive link below.
- Laura / Ben: validate the decision-maker contact details in each playbook and flag any legal/contract entanglements.

I'll own the QBR slide skeleton and the executive summary. If you have pushback on the one-pager template by EoD today call it out.

Thanks — keep this asynchronous unless there are open items needing a quick sync.

Priya Natarajan
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: QBR-template-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), avery-account-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR prep: runway consolidation + account playbooks (Avery Health & top mid-market accounts)

Priya / team —

Attached is the initial rollup (forecast-rollup-20261109.csv). Quick highlights:
- Consolidated ARR coverage for target cohort: $5.2M ARR
- Weighted forecast (next 90 days): $1.1M (mid-case)
- Net-new risk: ~$600k has low-confidence close dates (60–90+ day slippage risk)
- Avery Health: currently showing $320k in late-stage expansion (probability 55%), renewal conversation scheduled 11/12.

Data notes: some AE rollups still list multiple opportunity owners for the same legal entity (I've marked duplicates in column "owner_note"). I recommend we standardize owner on the playbook to the exec sponsor and list technical owner separately.

Next steps: I'll push a cleaned CSV to the Drive by EoD Tue after reconciling duplicates. If Marissa needs a different field layout in the CSV for programmatic embedding into the playbooks, let me know now.

-Rishi
Head of Forecasting
Redwood Inference

Attachments: forecast-rollup-20261109.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR prep: runway consolidation + account playbooks (Avery Health & top mid-market accounts)

Thanks — I started the Avery playbook and attached a first draft (avery-account-playbook-v1.pdf). High level: decision maker is still Sasha Cole (CIO), technical champion is Dr. Patel (AI Ops). Primary blocker: procurement wants a SOC 2 addendum and a clarification on data residency for logs.

I've created playbooks for two additional at-risk accounts (summaries below). I'll finish formatting and upload PDFs to the Drive link by EoD Wed.

Account: Meridian Clinics
- ARR: $180k
- Risk: procurement moved to Q2 renewal window, AE estimates 30% chance of conversion this quarter
- Recommended action: schedule legal + procurement deep-dive; assign Ben as escalation owner (ETA: 11/13)

Account: Helix Labs
- ARR: $95k
- Risk: technical validation outstanding (performance at 20k tokens/sec target)
- Recommended action: scope a short POC with Redwood Dedicated (2-week burst), owner: Marissa (ETA: 11/20)

Avery notes: I've left the renewal play as "priority" and added the list of required SOC questions in appendix. Ben — can you confirm procurement contact at Avery?

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

Attachments: avery-account-playbook-v1.pdf

From: Sara Mills <sara@averyhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: renewals@averyhealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 16:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR prep: runway consolidation + account playbooks (Avery Health & top mid-market accounts)

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the preview and the playbook draft, Marissa. Confirming we have the renewal discussion on 11/12 at 10:00am PT. I'll bring our procurement lead (Tara Singh) and our security engineer for the SOC questions. Two quick asks from our side before the meeting:

1) Can you provide a short note on your data residency approach for inference logs? Our security team wants a one-paragraph summary in advance.
2) If you have a succinct summary of the performance SLA for the Dedicated option (latency guarantees and outage credit policy), please forward prior to the call.

If you can send those two items by tomorrow EoD we'll be in good shape for the renewal call.

Best,
Sara Mills
Director, Cloud Procurement
Avery Health
